problem_summary: Customer reports the air conditioner is not cooling.
recommendation: Schedule an AC diagnostic. Repairs start at $89. If the unit is over 12 years old, we recommend discussing a replacement for better long-term efficiency.

problem_summary: Customer reports the furnace or heater is not working.
recommendation: Book a heating diagnostic. Most furnace repairs start at $99. Annual maintenance helps prevent unexpected breakdowns.

problem_summary: Customer has unusually high energy costs.
recommendation: An efficiency inspection, duct cleaning, or system upgrade can significantly reduce energy costs. We can assess your current system.

problem_summary: Customer is moving into a new home or building.
recommendation: Request a free estimate for a new HVAC system installation sized and designed for your space.

problem_summary: Customer wants a routine maintenance check.
recommendation: Book a seasonal tune-up starting at $79. We clean, inspect, and optimize your system before peak heating or cooling season.

problem_summary: Customer hears unusual sounds from their HVAC unit.
recommendation: Unusual sounds often indicate a mechanical issue. Schedule a diagnostic before it becomes a larger repair.

problem_summary: Customer is concerned about indoor air quality.
recommendation: Duct cleaning and air quality assessments can help. We also install air purifiers and UV sanitizers.
